text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual's visit to Bahrain and Qatar has built a bridge in the relationship between the Maghreb and the Gulf region.
- Juge Berrim Mohamed el Hadi was elected head of the magistrates' union.
- The state will lower farmers' debt ahead of 1996/97 agricultural season.
- Political parties are preparing startegies on the referendum to amend the constitution.
- The Transitional National Council will vote on an election law on Monday.
